Kate, Dylan — uploading the technical packet to the shared Drive now. Summary of practical options re: retention / audit logs:

- Retention: We can accept 3 years for audit logs as a standard position. 7 years creates storage and compliance impacts for some regional processors; if AlpenBank requires 7 years, we will propose a compensating control: encrypted cold storage with KMS separable keys and an annual attestation.
- Monthly exports: We can automate a monthly audit-log export (CSV + signed manifest). This will land in the shared folder and we can provide an ingestion spec for your tooling.
- Live architecture walkthrough: we'll run the session remote and share redacted diagrams; for requests that need deeper visibility we can arrange a recorded session for your compliance team.

I've added proposed language for Art.28 access scope and a note on synthetic data sampling in the runbook. If procurement can accept 3 years + compensating control for 7-year requests, we can sign off the DPA redline later today.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Privacy Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
